text:
emma_mkt: Final greenroom checks for Friday's "Serve Better" webinar. Quick confirm on reg page timezone rendering, Zoom recording, and post-event flow?

jordi_ops: Zoom: webinar mode, cloud record MP4 + SRT, co-hosts = @emma_mkt,@jordi_ops. Retention NA=90d EMEA=30d. RTMP fallback set to rtmp://fallback.cdn/live.

sophia_growth: Registration page live. Added dropdown: 'main interest' -> maps to HubSpot property `interest_area`. UTM: utm_source=organic&utm_campaign=serve_better_may. Also added GDPR checkbox.

miguel_social: I'll own clips + social. Plan: auto-create 3 clips (intro, benchmark, Q&A) and one 60s hero. Upload path: s3://redwood-marketing/serve-better/{date}/clips.

jordi_ops: Post-event script:
```
1) confirm recording link in #marketing within 60m
2) download mp4 + srt
3) run pii-scrub on transcript
4) run clipper -> upload clips
5) post internal link + notify owners
```
I'll take step 1 and 2.

emma_mkt: Sales routing: live attendees with interest_area=enterprise -> AE alert within 12h. Replay viewers who click pricing -> SDR outreach at 48h. Mapping in sheet row 7.

sophia_growth: Zapier test passed (registrant -> enrich -> HS upsert). (zapier-bot: TEST OK)

miguel_social: Small ask: add utm for social paid variant: utm_campaign=serve_better_paid.

emma_mkt: Done. Who monitors chat during the event?

miguel_social: I'll monitor chat and flag questions for clips. @sophia_growth will triage leads.

zoom-bot: Reminder: webinar starts in 24 hours. Hosts: emma_mkt. Co-hosts: jordi_ops, miguel_social. Cloud recording enabled.

emma_mkt: Thanks team  owners recap: @miguel_social (clips + social), @jordi_ops (zoom + upload), @sophia_growth (lead routing). See you in the greenroom :white_check_mark:
